name: roll20-embetterment
description: Firefox-first Roll20 combat HUD, separate Chrome extension, optional legacy userscript

scripts.check:firefox: npm run build && npm run build:firefox && npm test && node --check dist/firefox/extension/content.js && node --check roll20-embetterment.user.js
scripts.check:chrome: npm run build:chrome && node --test tests/chrome-extension.spec.mjs && node --check dist/chrome/extension/content.js
